tool_args.rationale: The pilot approaches the archived critical-gradient range, and the targeted probe reveals a steep supercritical collapse. Fit all five avalanche-law parameters numerically and assess the law on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient measurements decline sharply and become negative, unlike the subcritical saturation trend.

considered_alternatives.option: Cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed abrupt high-gradient collapse matches the archived threshold mechanism more directly.
The eight observations cover both sides of the threshold and support fitting the five-parameter static avalanche law; additional trajectory measurements are not needed for its identification.
It does not discriminate the proposed mechanisms.
